item.title: Workloads and Benchmarking Team Lead - Microsoft
item.description:
As the Workloads and Benchmarking Team Lead, you will lead the Specialized Workloads and Benchmarking group, owning the strategy and execution of benchmarking for Azure HPC and AI infrastructure. You will develop deep expertise in HPC and AI workloads, define representative and credible benchmarking methodologies, and drive external publication of results that influence customer adoption and internal platform design. This role combines hands-on technical leadership with people management, including coaching, mentoring, and growing a high-performing team of engineers.

Location: Remote USA

Categories: Cloud, HPC, Industry, IC Leadership, Software Development
